title: Orbit
description: Icons in orbit around a center: two rings, two speeds, everything staying upright.
usage: A hero device for "things that work around your product" — integrations, features, the catalog itself. Two rings is the composition limit; a third is a solar system. Chips counter-rotate so the glyphs never tilt: the ring travels, the icons ride.
a11y: The orbit is a picture of the list, so give the figure an aria-label naming what circles ("Integrations orbiting the workspace") and keep a real list nearby in the page. Under prefers-reduced-motion the rings stop mid-sky, upright and readable.
